pond-minnow.name: Pond Minnow
pond-minnow.desc: Tiny and quick. Good in a stew.

sunfish.name: Garden Sunfish
sunfish.desc: Round and golden. It likes the sun.

moon-carp.name: Moon Carp
moon-carp.desc: A pale carp that only wakes at night.

golden-koi.name: Golden Koi
golden-koi.desc: A rare koi. Shiny as a coin.

forest-trout.name: Forest Trout
forest-trout.desc: A speckled trout from the forest pond.

mossy-bass.name: Mossy Bass
mossy-bass.desc: Green as the moss on the rocks.

glow-eel.name: Glow Eel
glow-eel.desc: It glows softly in the dark water.

silver-salmon.name: Silver Salmon
silver-salmon.desc: A rare, strong fish. It fights hard!

frost-perch.name: Frost Perch
frost-perch.desc: A chilly little fish from under the ice.

icicle-pike.name: Icicle Pike
icicle-pike.desc: Long and sharp, like an icicle.

aurora-char.name: Aurora Char
aurora-char.desc: Its scales shimmer like the northern lights.

soggy-boot.name: Soggy Boot
soggy-boot.desc: Someone lost this. It smells awful.
